segments.text: Welcome back to the Creator Lab podcast, I'm your host and today we're talking thumbnails.
First thing: create a thumbnail with motion blur so it reads as action.
You should always put your face on the left third of the frame.
Make sure you export at 4K even if your audience watches on phones.
What I'd do is redo the whole intro and cut it to under ten seconds.
Don't forget to add captions, they boost retention a lot.
You want to batch record three videos every Sunday.
Thanks for listening, see you next week.
